usedFor: Stripe knows who pays you, and Google Contacts stores them when “New Customer Created” runs “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer Created” in Stripe, then “Create Contact” in Google Contacts
bestTemplate.why: Each new Stripe customer is saved as a Google contact, so your address book keeps up with paying people.

watchOut: “Add Contact to Group” finds an existing contact, so run “Create Contact” first when the customer is new.
